column4: Play-tile ARTWORK, not a UI frame: Plinko desktop card art 195x277. get_metadata returns zero children - it is a single image-fill card with no structure to implement. 195x277 is exactly the card slot the game pages already render via FIGMA_GAME_ART, so the work here is dropping a .webp into assets/games/figma/ and adding one line to playGameArt.ts, not building a component. Nothing to render or screenshot.
